regression: Omitted or null photo values preserve an owned business/offer image; empty values remove it; replacement and same-store restart are verified.
source_sync: Updates and rollback preserve assets/photos, ignore source photos, and reject overlapping paths, symlinks and Windows reparse points before mutation. An actual read-only POSIX photo bind was tested.
independent_review: Scoped acceptance of source-sync path safety and photo-default compatibility; no overall production A claim.
retained_failure: The first core attempt failed two database-dependent tests because embedded PostgreSQL did not become ready. The same source passed with a dedicated owned PostgreSQL instance; no assertion was removed.
limitations: Local verification only; GitHub CI status is separate.
The Jac core runner skipped six cases; the Jac insights backend runner skipped one. Skips do not count as passing coverage.
Linux tooling skipped two Windows junction cases and a case-insensitive filesystem case; Windows junction cases were verified separately.
Coordinated durable backup/restore of photos, real private ownership database and graph data remains open.
Bind proof used a private-registry sentinel; it does not certify database recovery.
Physical Safari/HEIC and large phone photos, representative merchant website import and real U-M inbox acceptance remain open.
Historical visual screenshots use source 54c0f42c; this follow-up changes backend compatibility and source-sync protection, not visual layout.
Derivative runtime source proof is separate and is not installed or adopted; capacity and sealed-runtime release acceptance remain open.
